title: quality_audit.py stops sending fix, re-audit and sample work to paused research
problem: Standalone research was paused on 2026-11-25 (prompts/goals.md, pivot point 11), but quality_audit.py still drew two research projects per sample round, ranked research defects in the fix queue, listed research subjects for re-audit, and counted research highs toward doubling the fix-mode weight. Quality runs (about a fifth of all runs) kept spending on paused work.
evidence: 2026-11-25, `quality_audit.py queue --severity high --no-git`: 20 of 21 open high defects were research/ subjects; the one venture row already had open PRs #19007 and #19008
2026-11-25, `quality_audit.py reaudit --no-prs`: 225 of 512 subjects waiting for a re-audit were research/
change: sample, census, queue, reaudit and mode leave research/ subjects out unless --research (quality_metrics.PAUSED_PREFIXES); metrics and coverage still count them; portfolio/quality/README.md says so.
metric: Quality fix and re-audit PRs merged that touch research/ per week
baseline: Never measured as a weekly count; on 2026-11-25 the queue's high rows were 20/21 research
source: process run 2026-11-25 (critique: quality queue read against the 2026-11-25 research pause)

history.note: Shipped the --research gate in quality_audit.py/quality_metrics.py. Verify: over the next week count merged `quality fix:` and re-audit PRs whose files are under research/; expect near zero.
